headline: Goldman Sachs Expands Asia Wealth Advisory to Capture US Asset Inflows
summary: Goldman Sachs is accelerating the hiring of wealth management advisers in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia to meet demand for US asset diversification.
why: Goldman Sachs is a leading global investment banking and financial services firm providing advisory, asset management, and securities underwriting.

impacts.name: Goldman Sachs
impacts.why: Expansion of wealth management advisory teams can increase fee-based revenue streams.
